title: Introducing Advanced Account Security
summary: Introducing Advanced Account Security: phishing-resistant login, stronger recovery, and enhanced protections to safeguard sensitive data and prevent account takeover.
body: Introducing Advanced Account Security: phishing-resistant login, stronger recovery, and enhanced protections to safeguard sensitive data and prevent account takeover.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了关于账户安全性的更新，包括防钓鱼登录和增强的恢复机制。此更新旨在保护用户敏感数据，与大模型核心技术研发无关。
